description: Uitdagingen-curation (Water & Bodem): versoepeling zonder verboden, stortplaats-verstrakking en een buffer op de grondwaterbeschermingszone.

scenarios.name: Groundwater-protection umbrella enforced only as 'rekening houden met'
scenarios.description: Drops the two hard exclusions of the grondwaterbeschermingszone umbrella (FR-BO-01 art. 3.7 winning-risk, FR-BO-03 art. 3.9 burial facilities), leaving only the art.-3.10 take-into-account condition — the weakest reading.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-BO-04 (art. 3.10) deliberately stays a conditional 'rekening houden met' marker; this variant re-adjudicates NC-BO-01/NC-BO-03 from hard exclusions to that weakest reading, returning ~701 km².

scenarios.name: Gesloten stortplaats treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-BO-05 (art. 3.108, 0.373 km²) is a context marker; this variant excludes the closed-landfill footprint for new soil activity.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-BO-05 (art. 3.108) carries the gesloten stortplaats as a context marker of provincial jurisdiction; this variant executes the protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Grondwaterbeschermingszone exclusion widened by a 500 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art.-3.7 exclusion (FR-BO-01) outward by 500 m — a protection-margin variant for the winning zone.

basis.variedAspect: exclusion zone widened by an added 500 m buffer; the exclusion itself is cited, the 500 m margin is the scenario's own parameter
basis.provenanceNote: NC-BO-01 (art. 3.7) carries the winning-risk exclusion; the 500 m widening is not cited and is the scenario's own parameter.
